name: nekkos
description: Local-first AI coding & cowork desktop app with first-class local model support.
author: ermish

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekkos/host && npm run build -w @nekkos/desktop
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @nekkos/shared && npm run build -w @nekkos/core
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekkos/host && npm run build -w @nekkos/cli && npm run build -w @nekkos/desktop && npm run build -w @nekkos/server && npm run build -w @nekkos/cloud
scripts.cloud: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekkos/host && npm run build -w @nekkos/desktop && npm run build -w @nekkos/cloud && npm run start -w @nekkos/cloud
scripts.local: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @nekkos/host && npm run build -w @nekkos/desktop && npm run start -w @nekkos/desktop
scripts.web: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @nekkos/server
scripts.bundle:web: npm run build:web && npm run bundle -w @nekkos/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nekkos/core && npm run test -w @nekkos/desktop && npm run test -w @nekkos/cloud
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/core && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/host && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/server && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/relay && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/cli && npm run typecheck -w @nekkos/cloud
scripts.relay: npm run build -w @nekkos/relay && npm run start -w @nekkos/relay
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @nekkos/desktop
